description: Find who on the shelf (Church Fathers, rabbis, mystics, reformers, commentators, philosophers) quotes a given Bible verse, with the quotation and a link. So far only 42 well-known verses are indexed (Genesis 1:1, Psalm 23:1, Isaiah 53:5, John 1:1, John 3:16, Romans 1:17 ...); "indexed": false means the verse is not on that list, not that nobody quotes it.
name: who_read_verse
